1_learned_vs_trained_uniform.statement: Five paired seeds and the locked two-comparison correction are not yet complete.

2_learned_vs_v2_continuation.statement: Five paired seeds and the locked two-comparison correction are not yet complete.

3_attribution.interpretation: Trained2x2 factorial. Original expert cores/head fine-tune in all cells;effects concern the added router and encoders. Frozen correction-off compares against the V3-refined inherited router,not original V2 weights.

4_history_dependence.interpretation: Stage-only gates fitted on independent diagnostic simulations;experts still use history. Observation swapping holds designs/stage fixed but is an artificial intervention. Weight variation alone is not evidence of EIG value.

answers.5_expert_contributions_note: Positive learned-minus-feature-removal EIG indicates a useful fusion contribution conditional on other experts. Router still sees that expert;this is not full information/path isolation. Feature similarities do not establish competency specialization.

resources.resource_scope: Includes smoke/diagnosis where resource files exist;training episode totals include completed principal runs only. Busy utilization integral is not exact GPU kernel time. Historical provider/pretraining cost not reconstructed here.

caveats: Case CIs condition on shared contrast bank;five seeds estimate continuation variability only.
Canonical bank has informed development;no untouched-test claim.
Wrapper computes instrumented descriptors for controls too;latency is not an optimized native V2 deployment benchmark.
No cost reward,balancing or diversity objective was introduced.
